component.name: PurrFind
component.summary: Fast, private file and content search for Linux

description.p: PurrFind provides instant filename and path search, full-text document search, local OCR, metadata filters, and rich previews from a private SQLite index.
Indexing is progressive and entirely local. PurrFind has no account, telemetry, upload, or cloud service.

screenshot.caption: PurrFind search overlay ready for an instant local query

description.p: Lower resident memory, responsive configuration and watch setup, automatic OCR pipeline refresh, and refined search UI.
First public beta release candidate with recovery, hardening, CI, and packaging.
